description: RPG Maker information database common Item schema. This file defines the stable data contract between collectors, archive, review, Slack and future WordPress.

internal_id.description: Stable internal identifier. Not displayed publicly.

pre_id.description: Human-review queue ID, assigned later when PRE workflow is introduced.

public_id.description: Public KN ID, assigned only when an item is approved for publication.

collector.description: Technical collector module name; separate from SITE master.

source_item_id.description: Stable identifier at the source when available; URL fallback is allowed.

category.description: Legacy/report category. Kept during migration; must not be used as the long-term database taxonomy.

registered_at.description: Registration into the future public database; do not populate merely because an item was collected.

design_rules: Collectors collect source data; they do not define the public database taxonomy.
SITE master records describe information sources. Collector modules are technical implementations and may change independently.
Do not delete excluded records; retain them for history and review.
Do not assign public KN IDs before human approval.
Do not copy or store source assets merely for cataloguing; store links and metadata.
Do not infer missing legal/licensing information as fact.
